paite: Joash in vaihawm apat tung in kum sagih a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmli vai ahawm a; anu min Zibiah, Beer-sheba mi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Joash / (2 Kum 12.1-16)

paite: Joash in siampu Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Jehoiada in amah zi nih aguan a, tapate leh tanute anei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in Joash in TOUPA' inn bawlphat lungsim in anei hi.

Siampute leh Levite akaikhawm a, "Judate khuate ah hoh unla kum teng a na Pathian inn uh bawlphatna ding in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah sum-le-pai khonkhawm unla, zekai kei un," achi hi. Himahleh Levite akintat tuan kei uhi.

Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Jehoiada asam a, akiang ah, "Bangziak a Levite TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel mipite seh theihsak a puanin a dia thoh bikhiah seh Judah mi leh Jerusalem mite thoh ding a phut lou na hia?
Migilou nu Athaliah tapate'n lah Pathian inn ahihse khinta ua, huan, TOUPA' inn a thillat tengteng Baalte ape khin behlap lai uh," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apia a, bawm abawl ua, TOUPA in kongpi polam ah akoih uhi.
Gamdai a Pathian sikha Mosi in Israel mite hih ding a thoh bikhiah a seh TOUPA a ding a thoh ding in Judah gam tengteng leh Jerusalem ah thu athangsakta hi.
Huchi in miliante leh mipite akipak ua, adangkate uh ahon la ua, akhon khit masiah uh bawm ah ahong koihkoih mai uhi.

Levite'n kumpipa upate kiang a bawm ahon tawi ua, dangka tampi a-om chih atheih un kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu kumpipa seh upa in bawm a kipan abungkhia a, ala ua, amun ah akoih nawn uh. Huchibang in niteng in ahih ua, dangka tampi akholkhawmta uhi.
Kumpipa leh Jehoiada in TOUPA' inn nasem mite khut ah apia ua, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in suangsek mite, khutsiamte, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in sik leh dal a khutsiamte leng aguai hi.
Huchi in nasem mite'n asem pan ua, asem hoih mahmah ua, Pathian inn angei bang geih in abawlhoih ua, adingkip nawnta hi.

Azoh un dangka om lai teng kumpipa leh Jehoiada kiang ah ahon tawi ua, huai in TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuante, latna tui-um belsuan sikkeute leh dangkasik tui-um belsuante nangawn abawl uhi. Huchi in Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA' inn ah halmang thillat alan gige uhi.
Jehoiada bel upapi tekkun a dam in asita. Asih in kum za-le-sawmthum a upa ahi.
heading: Jehoiada Thiltup Hong Kilehbulh

paite: Huchi in Israelte lak ah Pathian tung ah leh a-inn tungtang a thil ahihhoih ziak in David khopi ah kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
Jehoiada sih nung in Judah miliante ahong kuan ua, kumpipa kiang ah toukaina abawl ua, kumpipa'n athu uh ana pom hi.
Himahleh apipute uh Pathian TOUPA' inn alehngatsan ua, Asherahte leh milimte nna asemta uh. Huchi in akhelhna uh ziak in Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah thangpaihna ahong tungta hi.
Himahleh TOUPA kiang a pikik ding in akiang uah zawlneite asawl a, amohdante uh atheisak ua, himahleh abil uh adoh nuam kei uhi.

Siampu Jehoiada tapa Zekariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung a, amah mipi tunglam ah adingh a, akiang uah, "Pathian in hichi in achi: Bangziak a na lamzan theihlouhna ding ua TOUPA' thupiakte bohsia na hi ua? TOUPA na lehngatsan ziak un ama'n leng nou hon lehngatsan ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in amah asawmta ua, kumpipa thupiak in TOUPA' inn huangsung ah suang in adenglumta uhi.
Huchibang in kumpipa Joash in apa Jehoiada hehpihna theigige lou in atapa athatta hi. Asih kuan in, "TOUPA'N ahon ngaihtuah ding a, phu ahon laksak ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum abei in Siria sepaihte'n ahong sual ua; Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah alut ua, amilian tengteng uh ahihmansak ua, Damaskas kumpipa kiang ah gallak tengteng akhak vek uhi.
heading: Joash Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna

paite: Siria sepaihte bel tawmchik kia ahong kuan ua; apipute uh Pathian TOUPA alehngatsan ziak un TOUPA'N sepaih tampite akhut uah apia ahi. Huchibang in Joash tung ah gawtna atungsak uhi.

Apaisan nung un, natna thupitak thuak in apaisan ua, amah mite ngei in siampu Jehoiada tapate sisan ziak in asawm ua, alupna a lum lai athat ua, asita hi. David khopi ah avui ua, himahleh kumpipate han ah aphum kei uhi.
Hiaite amah sawm mite ahi uh: Ammon mi Simeath tapa Zabad leh Moab mi Shimrith tapa Jehozabad.

Huchi in atapate tung ah thute, atung a puakgiktak puaksak tungtang thute; Pathian in abawlhoiht tungtang thute, ngai dih Kumpite Tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh ahi. Huan asik in atapa Amaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
